Description
The 20 gram Credit Suisse Vintage gold bar is one of those marvelous products which is the best option for investors, collectors, and buyers.
The 20 gram Gold Bar Credit Suisse has a unique serial number and an assay certificate are among the measures that contribute to the bar’s authenticity and integrity.
These Credit Suisse Vintage Gold Bars are getting scarce as Credit Suisse has ceased production.
They were minted at the Valcambi Mint in Switzerland.
Design Of the
20 gram Credit Suisse Vintage gold bar
Credit Suisse was one of the first banks to become involved in the precious metals industry in the 1970’s, and as a result has maintained its name as one of the premier brands of bullion bars
The obverse of the Swiss gold bar has the Credit Suisse logo engraved on the top of the bar. Its face also has the weight, metal content, and purity of the bar engraved. The additional engraving on the bar includes the assay mark and the serial number of the bar.
The Swiss Gold Bar’s reverse features the repeated logo of Credit Suisse at a diagonal angle covering the entire reverse side of the bar.
Each gold bar will come with its own Assay certificate.
Main Highlights of the
20 gram Credit Suisse Vintage gold bar
This product contains 0.0643 troy oz of .9999 fine gold.
These products are manufactured in Switzerland by Credit Suisse.
